methods.title: Raw and structured mnemonic checks
methods.scope: Recorded strict candidate sets and first receive addresses on BIP44/49/84.
methods.result: No activity in the tested candidates; this does not exhaust seed-based encodings.
limitations: Older 2,051-word list was corrected to the official 2,048-word list.
Filtered ordinary prose can generate chance valid checksums.

methods.title: Highlight-derived mnemonic checks
methods.scope: Recorded 350 strict highlight candidates and 1,050 standard addresses.
methods.result: No activity reported in the stated set.
limitations: A broad family is not exhausted by this finite set.

methods.title: Fold and mirror geometry
methods.scope: Recorded scan registration and reflected-mask experiments.
methods.result: Some geometric/semantic correspondences; no deterministic extraction established.
limitations: Many older leaf pairings were wrong.
Chosen overlaps and article context do not prove intent.

methods.title: Historical 17-edge phrase-box claim
methods.scope: The exact old phrase matcher and all 17 medium/strong graph records.
methods.result: Noncontiguous token matches invalidate that graph statistic as intentional phrase alignment.
limitations: Later independent scan-native measurements are separate.

methods.title: Font and partial-bold hypothesis
methods.scope: Source typography, reconstructed font runs and investigator annotations.
methods.result: Typeka variants explain much apparent partial bolding; no decoded message established.
limitations: Reconstructed Word annotations are not original magazine metadata.
Some inputs are excluded or unavailable.

methods.title: Corrected fixed orange-mask reflections
methods.scope: 20 ordered page pairs,80 direct streams; no offset fitting.
methods.result: No exact checksum-bearing WIF or 64-hex output.
limitations: Only the declared source masks and registration.

methods.title: Correct physical-leaf inverted bars
methods.result: Ordinary target prose/art fragments and no WIF/64-hex candidate.

methods.title: George Sand / Musset printed body lines
methods.scope: 142 visually reconstructed body lines; declared parity, edge and reversal variants.
methods.result: No valid literal key, contiguous mnemonic or clear hidden instruction in the recorded streams.
limitations: Variant counts are correlated formulations, not independent theories.

methods.title: George Sand / Musset highlighted physical lines
methods.scope: 46 colored fragments on45 baselines;540 declared variants.
methods.result: One weak short-key checksum hit; all 5 tested address types had zero transactions.

methods.title: Literal 32-byte line-edge candidates
methods.scope: 12 exact ASCII scalar candidates from the two32-line pages;60 addresses.
methods.result: Zero confirmed/pending transactions in successful recorded lookups.
limitations: ASCII interpretation is an added hypothesis.

methods.title: Exact first-word SHA-256 control
methods.scope: 36 case-preserving first-word strings, one SHA256 each;180 addresses.
methods.result: Zero confirmed/pending transactions in successful recorded lookups.
limitations: Hash wrapper is conjectural, not a creator instruction.

methods.title: Source-faithful 24-number / 256-bit rule
methods.scope: Exact24-number rule, four declared source/bit-order mirror forms;20 addresses.
methods.result: All 20 lookups succeeded; zero transaction activity.
limitations: Excludes three ordinal first occurrences and pronoun ONE; includes Forty/six/zero.
Another ordinary serialization yields264 bits. Length alone is not proof.

methods.title: Alternative OVERDOSE column
methods.scope: Recorded356 OCR-assisted printed lines and declared readings.
methods.result: No literal key or clear hidden instruction in the tested set.
limitations: OCR-assisted source and unavailable comparison raster inputs limit complete reproduction.

methods.title: Public creator-post evidence
methods.scope: Four verified public posts; exact source links and caveats.
methods.result: Method pointers and a prize claim; no authenticated funding address or solution.

methods.title: Independent author-controlled manuscript
methods.scope: A genuine pre-layout manuscript with provenance.
methods.result: No such authoritative manuscript is in this release.
limitations: An unavailable input is not a failed experiment.

countingPolicy: This is a curated set of method families/source audits, not a total count of independent theories. Historical administrative gates and correlated variants are not counted as independent experiments. Falsified means only the concrete stated candidate/address scope.
historicalRecordPolicy: All retained historical documents are redacted copies; older broad conclusions are superseded by scoped corrections.
